node.description: This controls the rotation

node.label: Current
node.description: Connect to pivot

node.description: Output to pivot

object.script:
function math.clamp(val, lower, upper) if lower > upper then lower, upper = upper, lower end -- swap if boundaries supplied the wrong way return math.max(lower, math.min(upper, val)) end
buffer = 0 endval = 0 inc = 0 function onTick() target = input.getNumber(1) max = property.getNumber("Max Degrees") / 360 min = property.getNumber("Min Degrees") / 360
timeplus = property.getNumber("Positive Rotation Time (s)") * 60 timeminus = property.getNumber("Negative Rotation Time (s)") * 60 speedlimit = property.getNumber("Speed Limit (RPS)") / 60
relative = property.getBool("Relative Mode") extrange = property.getBool("Relative Input") limit = property.getBool("Rotation Limit")
if not limit then value = target else if relative then range = max - min if extrange then average = (max + min) / 2 value = average + range / 2 * math.clamp(target, -1, 1) else value = min + range * math.clamp(target, 0, 1) end else value = math.clamp(target, min, max) end end
if value ~= buffer then inc = value - endval
if (value > buffer) and (timeplus > 0) then inc = inc / timeplus end
if (value < buffer) and (timeminus > 0) then inc = inc / timeminus end
if speedlimit ~= 0 then inc = math.clamp(inc, -speedlimit, speedlimit) end
buffer = value end
endval = math.clamp(endval + inc, endval, value)
output.setNumber(1, endval)
end

--Simplifications and start values i,o,m,p,t,f,pitch,roll,heading,gx2,gy2,gz2,droll=input,output,math,property,true,false,0,0,2,0,0,0,0 pi2 = m.pi * 2
function clamp(x, y, z) local o = m.min(m.max(x, y), z) return o end
function onTick() launch = i.getBool(1) --Save launch boolean
if launch then --Only run if launched --Make sure a target heading is saved before starting program if heading == 2 then heading = i.getNumber(17) else --Inputs gain = p.getNumber("Steering Gain") targetA = p.getNumber("Target Altitude") diveAngle = p.getNumber("Dive Angle") targetS = p.getNumber("Target Speed") gainT = p.getNumber("Throttle Gain") gainA = p.getNumber("Altitude Gain") gainR = p.getNumber("Rudder Gain") gx = i.getNumber(1) altitude = i.getNumber(2) gz = i.getNumber(3) rollx = i.getNumber(10) rollz = i.getNumber(12) speed = i.getNumber(13) pitch2 = i.getNumber(15) roll = i.getNumber(16) compass = i.getNumber(17)
--Guidance roll = roll + ((m.abs(pitch2) * roll) / (0.25 - m.abs(pitch2))) --Roll angle pitch corrector rollS = rollz * m.cos(compass * pi2) - rollx * m.sin(compass * pi2) --Global to local roll speed gxs,gys,gzs,rolls = gx-gx2, altitude-gy2, gz-gz2, roll-droll --Deltas pitch = m.atan(gys, m.sqrt((gxs^2) + (gzs^2))) / pi2 --Speed based pitch elevation = clamp((targetA - altitude) * gainA, -diveAngle, diveAngle) - pitch --Target elevation compass = -m.atan(gxs, gzs) / pi2 --Speed based compass bearing = clamp((((heading - compass + 1.5) % 1) - 0.5) * gainR, -0.125, 0.125) --Target bearing

--Simplifications and start values i,o,m,p,t,f,pitch,roll,heading,gx2,gy2,gz2,droll=input,output,math,property,true,false,0,0,2,0,0,0,0 pi2 = m.pi * 2
function clamp(x, y, z) local o = m.min(m.max(x, y), z) return o end
function onTick() launch = i.getBool(1) --Save launch boolean
if launch then --Only run if launched --Make sure a target heading is saved before starting program if heading == 2 then heading = i.getNumber(17) else --Inputs gain = p.getNumber("Steering Gain") targetA = p.getNumber("Target Altitude") diveAngle = p.getNumber("Dive Angle") targetS = p.getNumber("Target Speed") gainT = p.getNumber("Throttle Gain") gainA = p.getNumber("Altitude Gain") gainR = p.getNumber("Rudder Gain") gx = i.getNumber(1) altitude = i.getNumber(2) gz = i.getNumber(3) rollx = i.getNumber(10) rollz = i.getNumber(12) speed = i.getNumber(13) pitch2 = i.getNumber(15) roll = i.getNumber(16) compass = i.getNumber(17)
--Guidance roll = roll + ((m.abs(pitch2) * roll) / (0.25 - m.abs(pitch2))) --Roll angle pitch corrector rollS = rollz * m.cos(compass * pi2) - rollx * m.sin(compass * pi2) --Global to local roll speed gxs,gys,gzs,rolls = gx-gx2, altitude-gy2, gz-gz2, roll-droll --Deltas pitch = m.atan(gys, m.sqrt((gxs^2) + (gzs^2))) / pi2 --Speed based pitch elevation = clamp((targetA - altitude) * gainA, -diveAngle, diveAngle) - pitch --Target elevation compass = -m.atan(gxs, gzs) / pi2 --Speed based compass bearing = clamp((((heading - compass + 1.5) % 1) - 0.5) * gainR, -0.125, 0.125) --Target bearing
--Only throttle if underwater if altitude < 0 then throttle = (targetS - speed) * gainT else throttle = 0 end --Detect when upside down if ((rolls > 0) and (rollS < 0)) or ((rollS > 0) and (rolls < 0)) then f = -1 else f = 1 end
--Matrix rotation so I can ignore roll R,B,E = roll*pi2,bearing*pi2,elevation*pi2 x = m.cos(B)*m.cos(E) y = (m.cos(R)*(m.sin(B)*m.cos(E))*f) - (m.sin(R)*(m.sin(E))) z = (m.sin(R)*(m.sin(B)*m.cos(E))) + (f * m.cos(R)*(m.sin(E))) --Vector to angle rudder = m.atan(y, x) / pi2 elevator = m.atan(z, m.sqrt((x)^2+(y)^2)) / pi2
--Delta variables gx2,gy2,gz2,droll=gx,altitude,gz,roll
